metric_naming.what_it_computes: 1 if the FIRST valid source appears within K, else 0 - averaged over queries. That is Hit@K (a.k.a. success@K), NOT recall.
metric_naming.verdict: MISNAMED: the figure is Hit@K. Consequence: a query with 3 valid sources of which the system returns 1 scores identically to one that returns all 3, so multi-source completeness is invisible.

multi_source.verdict: any ONE valid source satisfies the metric; requiring every evidence group would score lower. Both are reported so the choice is explicit rather than hidden in the metric name.

ndcg.ideal: built from the number of relevant documents in the window, not a fixed 1
ndcg.verdict: recomputation agrees with the stored values
